params.msgs: 0..8 message slips land on the tray in order, left to right (slip i shows when msgs > i; 0, 2, 4, 6 are blue: the user)
params.scan: 0..1 the reading head sweeps from the note holder (0) to the last slip slot (1); slip i sits at (i + 1) / 8 of the sweep
params.read: 0..1 the lens lights yellow and a beam falls on the slip (or note) under the head
params.note: 0..1 the yellow memory note drops into the holder at the head of the tray
params.lit: 0..1 the first slip (the one that says the dog's name) turns yellow
params.mid: 0..1 slips 2..5 fade to 20 % (read worst in the middle)
